inputs.name: Static RAM root with console and Wi-Fi tools

scenario: On one operator-reported ESP-Mosaico V1.2 sample, boot the ESP_MOSAICO_SC101IOT_WIFI kernel in normal multiuser RAM mode and attempt the selected WPA3/SAE profile with PMF required.
expected: The selected BSS passes vendor compatibility checks, SAE completes, association uses PMF, and the interface obtains an IP address for data exchange.
observed: On one operator-reported V1.2 sample, SAE commit and confirm succeeded. The vendor then delivered association callback subtype 1 with a 321-byte response body; EmberBSD published net80211 RUN (state 4). At 25.972 s after kernel boot, EmberBSD logged local INIT with old state 4 and arg -1, then entered join-worker teardown and called disconnect. The vendor sent disassoc(8) and reported reason 8 at about 26.05 s. The trace does not establish which ioctl or event requested INIT. No WPA_COMPLETED, negotiated key management/PMF, DHCP/DNS or data exchange was observed. The wpa_cli monitor attached after RUN and saw no later control events; this does not cover earlier events. No dedicated vendor EAPOL-callback marker was recorded, which does not rule out EAPOL on the normal Ethernet RX path. At about 33.832 s, UVM killed the user shell (`sh`, the `/bin/console-tools` multicall alias) for out-of-swap while a multi-call dmesg pipeline was running; capture ended without a status snapshot.
limits: One operator-reported V1.2 sample and RAM-only trial; this does not establish another board revision or persistent installation.
The RAM root is identified by role only; its private configuration is not part of this shared record.
Observed times are kernel uptime; the full capture duration is not established. The private capture and its path are not part of this shared record.
The supplicant monitor attached after RUN, so its silence does not cover earlier events. No vendor EAPOL callback marker was seen; this does not exclude normal Ethernet EAPOL RX.
The local INIT and subsequent disconnect are observed, but the triggering ioctl/event is unproven. No WPA_COMPLETED, negotiated PMF, DHCP/DNS or data exchange was established.
UVM killed the user shell for out-of-swap during the multi-call dmesg pipeline, and capture ended before a status snapshot.
WPA2-only authentication, reconnect, roaming and sustained transfer remain unaccepted.
